title: Core: AS2 conditional compilation and version pragmas
description: Verify AS2 #include-style conditional compilation pragmas don't crash the compiler. If the compiler doesn't support #include, it should throw a meaningful error or skip. Also verify: var x:Number (typed variable), function f(x:String, y:Number):Boolean typed params/return. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/typedsyntax.test.ts.
